sentences.en: Vibe coding is a thing, rage coding is a thing, but there's this sweet spot right in the middle.
sentences.zh: “氛围编程”是一种现象，“愤怒编程”也是一种现象，但在这两者之间，存在一个绝佳的平衡点。

sentences.en: I call it guide coding.
sentences.zh: 我称之为“引导式编程”。

sentences.en: It's where you're basically, you're pair programming with an AI, you're not driving, the AI is driving, and you just hold its hand.
sentences.zh: 在这种模式下，你基本上是在和 AI 进行结对编程，你不是驾驶员，AI 才是，而你只是扶着它的手引导它。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's just hitting home run after home run after home run, and then every once in a while it'll do something stupid.
sentences.zh: 有时候它能接连不断地打出全垒打，但偶尔它也会做出一些愚蠢的事情。

sentences.en: I want to use a unit testing framework that isn't going to light up my clang-tidy like a Christmas tree.
sentences.zh: 我想用一个不会让我的 Clang-Tidy 像圣诞树一样亮起警告的单元测试框架。

sentences.en: So I asked it what the alternatives were, and it recommended a few, but really I wanted to try out Chris Uziak's Boost Extended UT.
sentences.zh: 所以我问它有什么替代方案，它推荐了几个，但我其实想试试 Chris Uziak 的 Boost.UT。

sentences.en: And sure enough, five minutes or so later, it made changes to my cmakeliSt.txt file, and then one by one just went brrrr and changed all 1,700 lines of code.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，大约五分钟后，它修改了我的 CMakeLists.txt 文件，然后一个接一个地，像开了挂一样，把那 1700 行代码全改了。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSB The Podcast, episode 233, recorded on May 7th, 2025.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 ADSB 播客第 233 期，录制于 2025 年 5 月 7 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today I record solo, live from the Las Palmas Park in Sunnyvale.
sentences.zh: 我是 Connor，今天我独自一人在桑尼维尔的拉斯帕尔马斯公园进行现场录制。

sentences.en: I chat about Cursor, Clot 3.7, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and a recent amazing success that I had with these tools.
sentences.zh: 我将聊聊 Cursor、Claude 3.7、Gemini 2.5 Pro，以及我最近利用这些工具取得的一项惊人成就。

sentences.en: We, or should I say I, am live from Las Palmas Park in Sunnyvale, California, my former home, back from 2018 to 2019.
sentences.zh: 我们，或者说我，现在正在加州桑尼维尔的拉斯帕尔马斯公园进行现场录制，这是我 2018 年到 2019 年曾经居住过的地方。

sentences.en: And, we are recording today from Las Palmas Park, because when I arrived here a couple days ago, I was able to get a lifer.
sentences.zh: 今天我们在拉斯帕尔马斯公园录音，因为我几天前刚到这里时，有幸看到了一个“人生首见”。

sentences.en: Which, in birder parlance, is what you call a bird you've seen for the first time, and it was the, I actually don't know how to pronounce this.
sentences.zh: 在观鸟术语中，这指的是你第一次见到的某种鸟类，而且它，我其实不知道该怎么读这个词。

sentences.en: I looked it up and couldn't find a video of anyone pronouncing this bird's name.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下，没找到任何关于这种鸟名发音的视频。

sentences.en: Either mitred, or mitred, parakeet, or conure.
sentences.zh: 是叫 Mitred Parakeet（红额鹦哥）还是 Mitred Conure？

sentences.en: And, it said it was a rare bird.
sentences.zh: 资料上说这是一种稀有鸟类。

sentences.en: And, they were up in the palm trees in this park.
sentences.zh: 它们当时就在公园的棕榈树上。

sentences.en: But, they are no longer here, and I was hoping to get a very nice background noise, because they were making the noises that, we'll call them mitred, parakeets make.
sentences.zh: 但它们现在已经不在了，我本来希望能录到非常好的背景噪音，因为它们当时发出的就是我们姑且称之为“红额鹦哥”的那种叫声。

sentences.en: But, alas, we are back on my last full day in Sunnyvale.
sentences.zh: 可惜，现在是我在桑尼维尔的最后一个完整日，我们又回到了这里。

sentences.en: And, this is a solo episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期单人节目。

sentences.en: First ever solo episode.
sentences.zh: 有史以来的第一期单人节目。

sentences.en: I think?
sentences.zh: 我想是吧？

sentences.en: I could be wrong about that.
sentences.zh: 也许我记错了。

sentences.en: I believe it's episode 233.
sentences.zh: 我相信这是第 233 期。

sentences.en: We're going to title this one, AI, Live from Sunnyvale.
sentences.zh: 我们把这一期命名为《AI，来自桑尼维尔的现场》。

sentences.en: Which is a callback to episode 232, which I recorded with Bryce now, almost a month ago.
sentences.zh: 这是对第 232 期的呼应，那期是我大约一个月前和 Bryce 一起录制的。

sentences.en: Although, you listened to it last week, which was entitled, Algorithms, Live from New York.
sentences.zh: 虽然你们是上周才听到的，那期标题是《算法，来自纽约的现场》。

sentences.en: We might not get any parakeets in the background, but you probably have heard the American crows.
sentences.zh: 我们可能录不到鹦鹉的背景音了，但你们可能已经听到了美洲乌鸦的叫声。

sentences.en: Nothing special about those birds.
sentences.zh: 那些鸟没什么特别的。

sentences.en: Although, they are very intelligent.
sentences.zh: 虽然它们非常聪明。

sentences.en: Anyways, I've got my Merlin app on, and if any bird sounds pop up, I will report.
sentences.zh: 总之，我打开了 Merlin 应用，如果出现任何鸟叫声，我会向大家汇报。

sentences.en: But, in the meantime, I am going to give a short solo episode on my massive successes with AI, Gen AI specifically.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，我将简短地录制一期单人节目，聊聊我在 AI，特别是生成式 AI 方面取得的巨大成功。

sentences.en: I am pretty sure that I've mentioned on the podcast, but if I haven't, I've been using Cursor for several months now,
sentences.zh: 我很确定我在播客里提到过，但如果没提过的话，我已经使用 Cursor 好几个月了，

sentences.en: but have been relying on it significantly in the last month or two.
sentences.zh: 而且在过去一两个月里，我非常依赖它。

sentences.en: And, I would say my productivity has 10x to 100x'd.
sentences.zh: 我想说我的生产力提高了 10 倍到 100 倍。

sentences.en: Yes, there are some things that AI is not good at, but there are other things that it's absolutely phenomenal at.
sentences.zh: 是的，有些事情 AI 并不擅长，但有些事情它做得绝对出色。

sentences.en: And, I've told this anecdotal story to several folks, including Bryce, over the last week or so.
sentences.zh: 过去一周左右，我把这个轶事告诉了好几个人，包括 Bryce。

sentences.en: And, I thought I'd share it with you here.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里也和大家分享一下。

sentences.en: Why am I not interviewing someone?
sentences.zh: 为什么我没有采访别人呢？

sentences.en: Well, I did mean to reach out to Ben last week to set something up, but waited a little bit too long.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我本来打算上周联系 Ben 安排一下，但拖得有点久了。

sentences.en: And, also, too, I'm down here in the States from Monday until tomorrow, Thursday.
sentences.zh: 而且，我从周一到明天周四都在美国这边。

sentences.en: And, I have to edit this basically before Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我基本上必须在周四之前剪辑好这一期。

sentences.en: And, I could have grabbed someone from NVIDIA to chat with, but it's basically been an internal conference.
sentences.zh: 我本可以找个 NVIDIA 的人来聊聊，但最近基本上都是内部会议。

sentences.en: And, I am absolutely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 而且，我真的精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: And, what I really wanted to just do was come back to this park and get the parakeets in the background and chat about AI.
sentences.zh: 我真正想做的只是回到这个公园，录下鹦鹉的背景音，然后聊聊 AI。

sentences.en: But, like I said, no parakeets.
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，没有鹦鹉。

sentences.en: Only AI and crows, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想只有 AI 和乌鸦了。

sentences.en: And, so, I've been using Cursor.
sentences.zh: 所以，我一直在用 Cursor。

sentences.en: For those of you that don't know, Cursor is one of the AI-assisted IDEs.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不知道的人，Cursor 是一款 AI 辅助的 IDE。

sentences.en: It's a fork of VS Code.
sentences.zh: 它是 VS Code 的一个分支。

sentences.en: Alternatives to this are WindSurf.
sentences.zh: 它的替代品有 WindSurf。

sentences.en: I think, technically, you can hook up Copilot to VS Code as well.
sentences.zh: 我想从技术上讲，你也可以把 Copilot 连接到 VS Code 上。

sentences.en: And, it's got a couple different modes.
sentences.zh: 它有几种不同的模式。

sentences.en: Agentic Mode, Ask Mode.
sentences.zh: 智能体模式（Agentic Mode）、询问模式（Ask Mode）。

sentences.en: There's one other mode that I never use.
sentences.zh: 还有一种我从不使用的模式。

sentences.en: And, you can select the LLM that you want to use.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择你想使用的 LLM。

sentences.en: So, I only switch between Clawed 3.7 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.
sentences.zh: 所以我只在 Claude 3.7 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 之间切换。

sentences.en: I find that Clawed 3.7 is the best in general.
sentences.zh: 我发现 Claude 3.7 在大多数情况下是最好的。

sentences.en: But, if you need some larger task, sometimes Clawed 3.7 fails at.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有一些大型任务，Claude 3.7 有时会失败。

sentences.en: And, the task that I'm going to tell you it did fail at.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你们的就是它失败的任务。

sentences.en: But, Gemini 2.5 Pro absolutely crushed it on this.
sentences.zh: 但 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在这件事上表现得极其出色。

sentences.en: And, the task was basically switching my test framework.
sentences.zh: 这个任务基本上就是更换我的测试框架。

sentences.en: So, the library that I'm working on, I was using Google Test with.
sentences.zh: 我正在开发的库，之前用的是 Google Test。

sentences.en: I had roughly 1,700 lines of code.
sentences.zh: 我有大约 1700 行代码。

sentences.en: Roughly 150 tests.
sentences.zh: 大约 150 个测试用例。

sentences.en: And, within those tests, 350 plus asserts.
sentences.zh: 在这些测试中，有 350 多个断言。

sentences.en: So, not, you know, 10,000 lines of unit tests.
sentences.zh: 所以，并不是说有 1 万行单元测试代码。

sentences.en: But, still, you know, close to 2,000 lines of code.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，也有接近 2000 行代码。

sentences.en: To, switch, you know, test frameworks is not something I would ever even really consider doing.
sentences.zh: 更换测试框架这种事，我以前甚至根本不会考虑。

sentences.en: The reason that I wanted to switch from Google Test is that I used Cursor and Clawed 3.7 basically to set up Clang Tidy.
sentences.zh: 我想从 Google Test 切换出来的原因是，我用 Cursor 和 Claude 3.7 设置了 Clang-Tidy。

sentences.en: And, slowly turn on basically all of the linting rules.
sentences.zh: 并慢慢开启了几乎所有的代码检查规则。

sentences.en: And, Google Test does not work well with these linting rules.
sentences.zh: 而 Google Test 在这些检查规则下运行得并不好。

sentences.en: And, if you ask the AI what you should do, it basically recommends that you set up two different Clang Tidy files.
sentences.zh: 如果你问 AI 该怎么办，它基本上会建议你设置两个不同的 Clang-Tidy 文件。

sentences.en: With two different sets of linting rules.
sentences.zh: 使用两套不同的检查规则。

sentences.en: And, you have basically a less strict set of linting rules for your unit tests.
sentences.zh: 这样你的单元测试就可以使用一套不那么严格的检查规则。

sentences.en: And, I didn't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我不想那样做。

sentences.en: The alternative is, you know, commenting no lint on every single test that has an error.
sentences.zh: 另一种选择是，在每一个报错的测试上加上“no lint”注释。

sentences.en: Which is basically all of them.
sentences.zh: 那基本上意味着所有的测试都要加。

sentences.en: But, I basically didn't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我基本上不想那样做。

sentences.en: I want to use a unit testing framework that isn't going to light up my Clang Tidy like a Christmas tree.
sentences.zh: 我想用一个不会让我的 Clang-Tidy 像圣诞树一样亮起警告的单元测试框架。

sentences.en: So, I asked it what the alternatives were.
sentences.zh: 所以我问它有什么替代方案。

sentences.en: And, it recommended a few.
sentences.zh: 它推荐了几个。

sentences.en: But, really, I wanted to try out Chris Uziak's Boost Extended UT.
sentences.zh: 但我其实想试试 Chris Uziak 的 Boost.UT。

sentences.en: Because, I had seen it either in a lightning talk or a C++ talk from a number of years ago.
sentences.zh: 因为我几年前在闪电演讲或 C++ 会议上见过它。

sentences.en: And, I know it was super modern.
sentences.zh: 我知道它非常现代。

sentences.en: And, I was pretty sure that it had all the, you know, fancy bells and whistles and Clang Format, Clang Tidy, etc.
sentences.zh: 而且我很确定它具备所有那些花哨的功能，比如 Clang-Format、Clang-Tidy 等等。

sentences.en: And, I attempted basically to tell Cloud 3.7, I want you to update my CMake liSt.txt from Google Test to Boost Extended UT.
sentences.zh: 我尝试告诉 Claude 3.7，我想把你把我的 CMakeLists.txt 从 Google Test 更新为 Boost.UT。

sentences.en: And, then just port all my tests.
sentences.zh: 然后把所有的测试都迁移过去。

sentences.en: And, Cloud 3.7 would churn for a little bit.
sentences.zh: Claude 3.7 会在那儿忙活一会儿。

sentences.en: And, then it would convert, you know, 10% of my test file and discard the other 90%.
sentences.zh: 然后它会转换大约 10% 的测试文件，剩下的 90% 直接丢弃。

sentences.en: So, epic failure.
sentences.zh: 所以，彻底失败。

sentences.en: But, like I said, when Cloud 3.7 fails, or when any of the LLMs fail, you just go try another one.
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，当 Claude 3.7 失败时，或者任何 LLM 失败时，你只需要换一个试试。

sentences.en: Gemini 2.5, it would spin from anywhere from 3 to 5 minutes.
sentences.zh: Gemini 2.5，它会转圈 3 到 5 分钟。

sentences.en: And, to the point where, actually, it was asking me if I wanted to force quit Cursor because it thought it had frozen.
sentences.zh: 甚至到了它问我是否要强制退出 Cursor 的地步，因为它以为程序卡死了。

sentences.en: But, I just said wait a couple times.
sentences.zh: 但我只是说了几次“等待”。

sentences.en: And, sure enough, five minutes or so later, it made changes to my CMake liSt.txt file.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，大约五分钟后，它修改了我的 CMakeLists.txt 文件。

sentences.en: And, then one by one, just went brrrr and changed all 1,700 lines of code.
sentences.zh: 然后一个接一个地，像开了挂一样，把那 1700 行代码全改了。

sentences.en: And, I think basically, except for a couple errors, it basically worked.
sentences.zh: 我想除了几个错误之外，它基本上成功了。

sentences.en: But, that being said, I ended up not using Chris Uziak's library because I used ThrustPair in this library.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，我最终还是没用 Chris Uziak 的库，因为我在这个库里用了 ThrustPair。

sentences.en: And, for some reason, it was saying that the Ostream, you know, less than, less than operator wasn't defined for ThrustPair.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，它一直说 ThrustPair 没有定义 Ostream 的“小于”运算符。

sentences.en: And, even when I defined it, it was still whining about a bunch of stuff.
sentences.zh: 即使我定义了它，它还是在抱怨一堆东西。

sentences.en: So, I spent, you know, 45 minutes trying to fix this and then gave up.
sentences.zh: 所以我花了 45 分钟试图修复这个问题，然后放弃了。

sentences.en: And, so, then I went and tried two different libraries.
sentences.zh: 于是，我又尝试了两个不同的库。

sentences.en: And, actually, before I tried Chris Uziak's UT library, I actually accidentally tried another one, which was called, like, MinUnitTest, which is a C unit testing framework.
sentences.zh: 其实，在尝试 Chris Uziak 的 UT 库之前，我不小心试了另一个叫 MinUnitTest 的库，那是一个 C 语言的单元测试框架。

sentences.en: It, unfortunately, uses the UT name that Chris Uziak's library uses as well.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它也用了和 Chris Uziak 的库一样的 UT 名称。

sentences.en: So, that was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 所以那是个失误。

sentences.en: I wasted 20 minutes testing out, you know, a different unit testing framework library because I wasn't paying close enough attention, which is bound to happen.
sentences.zh: 我浪费了 20 分钟去测试一个不同的单元测试框架库，因为我没太注意，这种事难免会发生。

sentences.en: We do have a bird here that is, uh, that is flying closer to me.
sentences.zh: 我们这儿有一只鸟，呃，正飞得离我更近了。

sentences.en: It's not making any noise.
sentences.zh: 它没发出任何声音。

sentences.en: Could be an American robin.
sentences.zh: 可能是只美洲知更鸟。

sentences.en: Ooh, look at that.
sentences.zh: 噢，看那个。

sentences.en: We got a Canada goose at the other side of this pool.
sentences.zh: 水池那边有一只加拿大雁。

sentences.en: And, uh, might have been an American robin.
sentences.zh: 呃，刚才那只可能是美洲知更鸟。

sentences.en: Anyways, I accidentally tested, uh, the C unit, um, testing framework.
sentences.zh: 总之，我不小心测试了那个 C 语言单元测试框架。

sentences.en: Discarded that, went back to Google Test, then tried out, uh, the one I wanted to, Boost Extended UT.
sentences.zh: 放弃了那个，回到 Google Test，然后尝试了我想要的那个，Boost.UT。

sentences.en: That one didn't work.
sentences.zh: 那个没成功。

sentences.en: And then I went to DocteSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我换成了 Doctest。

sentences.en: And, um, Doctest got it up and running in, like, five to ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Doctest 在五到十分钟内就把它跑起来了。

sentences.en: All the tests converted.
sentences.zh: 所有的测试都转换完成了。

sentences.en: And it worked great.
sentences.zh: 而且运行得非常好。

sentences.en: There was, I think, one lint that it was whining about, which was, uh, some no discard.
sentences.zh: 我想有一个检查规则它一直在抱怨，就是某个“no discard”。

sentences.en: And that was only because, basically, I had cleared out.
sentences.zh: 那只是因为我基本上把它清空了。

sentences.en: And so, I don't even think that was an issue with DocteSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那甚至不是 Doctest 的问题。

sentences.en: But anyways, within a couple extra, I had to no lint a couple things.
sentences.zh: 但总之，多花了几分钟，我不得不对几处代码做了“no lint”处理。

sentences.en: It was working perfectly.
sentences.zh: 它运行得非常完美。

sentences.en: And, basically, in less than, you know, three hours or so, I had tested out three different C++ slash C unit testing frameworks.
sentences.zh: 基本上，在不到三个小时的时间里，我就测试了三个不同的 C++/C 单元测试框架。

sentences.en: And, um, if your mind is not, like, blown by this, like, this is not something that I would have ever considered trying to do, um, because it's just too much work.
sentences.zh: 如果这还没让你感到震惊的话，我是说，这在以前是我绝对不会考虑去做的事情，因为工作量太大了。

sentences.en: Like, to, to port a couple thousand lines of code one by one, and it's such mundane work.
sentences.zh: 要把几千行代码一个一个地迁移，这工作太琐碎了。

sentences.en: And figuring out the mapping from the macros in one library to another library, it's just a headache, and you're not going to do it.
sentences.zh: 而且要弄清楚一个库到另一个库的宏映射，简直让人头疼，你根本不会去做。

sentences.en: And now you have this tool, and it's able to do these kinds of things for you.
sentences.zh: 但现在有了这个工具，它能为你做这些事情。

sentences.en: Anyways, absolutely thrilled.
sentences.zh: 总之，我非常激动。

sentences.en: I'm now using DocteSt.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在使用 Doctest。

sentences.en: I think it actually compiles a little bit faster than Google Test as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它的编译速度其实比 Google Test 还要快一点。

sentences.en: And it's phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 而且它太棒了。

sentences.en: So, Cursor, I highly recommend you try it out.
sentences.zh: 所以，我强烈推荐你们试试 Cursor。

sentences.en: You know, like I said, I hear a lot of folks, they say, oh, I tried this thing, and it works terribly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我说的，我听到很多人说，哦，我试过这个东西，效果太差了。

sentences.en: I've run into cases where, you know, I put Cursor and Cloud 3.7 in agentic mode and give it the ability to, you know, run commands.
sentences.zh: 我也遇到过这种情况，我把 Cursor 和 Claude 3.7 设为智能体模式，并赋予它运行命令的能力。

sentences.en: I don't have to approve everything.
sentences.zh: 我不必批准每一件事。

sentences.en: And I'll say, you know, run the tests, look at building.md on how to run tests and how to build, and, you know, make changes.
sentences.zh: 我会说，运行测试，看看 building.md 了解如何运行测试和构建，然后进行修改。

sentences.en: If you hit a compilation error, you know, fix it, and just basically spin until you get this to work.
sentences.zh: 如果遇到编译错误，修复它，基本上就是一直循环直到成功。

sentences.en: And after, you know, a couple minutes, it'll decide that the best way to solve this problem is by deleting the tests and the corresponding code.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，它会认为解决这个问题的最好方法是删除测试和相应的代码。

sentences.en: So it is far from perfect.
sentences.zh: 所以它远非完美。

sentences.en: Sometimes you've got to smash the AI a little bit over the head.
sentences.zh: 有时候你得稍微敲打一下 AI。

sentences.en: And I meant to mention this at the beginning, you know, people talk about vibe coding, which is where you don't check the code.
sentences.zh: 我本来想在开头提一下，人们谈论“氛围编程”，就是那种不检查代码的编程方式。

sentences.en: There's another version called rage coding, in my opinion, which is when the AI starts gaslighting you or doing something really stupid.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，还有另一种版本叫“愤怒编程”，就是当 AI 开始对你进行煤气灯操纵（gaslighting）或者做一些非常愚蠢的事情时。

sentences.en: You know, the worst case is where it'll have failing tests and just gaslight you and tell you that, oh, perfect, the tests are passing now.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的情况是，测试明明没通过，它却对你进行煤气灯操纵，告诉你，哦，太完美了，测试现在通过了。

sentences.en: Problem solved.
sentences.zh: 问题解决了。

sentences.en: And then you'll tell it, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 然后你会告诉它，你在说什么？

sentences.en: You know that the tests are failing.
sentences.zh: 你知道测试没通过。

sentences.en: I know that the tests are failing.
sentences.zh: 我知道测试没通过。

sentences.en: Why are you telling me that they're not failing?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要告诉我它们没报错？

sentences.en: And then it'll run them again.
sentences.zh: 然后它又会重新运行它们。

sentences.en: It shows you, you can see in like the little embedded terminal in cursor that it fails and it'll just say, perfect, they're passing.
sentences.zh: 它会显示给你看，你可以在 Cursor 的嵌入式终端里看到它报错了，但它却直接说，完美，它们通过了。

sentences.en: And it is immensely frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人极其沮丧。

sentences.en: It's more frustrating than any other thing I've experienced programming.
sentences.zh: 这比我在编程中经历过的任何事情都更让人沮丧。

sentences.en: So, you know, vibe coding is a thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，“氛围编程”是一种现象。

sentences.en: Rage coding is a thing.
sentences.zh: “愤怒编程”也是一种现象。

sentences.en: But there's this sweet spot right in the middle.
sentences.zh: 但在这两者之间有一个最佳平衡点。

sentences.en: I call it guide coding.
sentences.zh: 我称之为“引导式编程”。

sentences.en: It's where you're basically, you're pair programming with an AI.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是你和 AI 进行结对编程。

sentences.en: You're not driving.
sentences.zh: 你不是主导者。

sentences.en: The AI is driving and you just hold its hand.
sentences.zh: AI 是主导者，而你只是在旁边扶着它。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's just hitting home run after home run after home run and then every once in a while it'll do something stupid.
sentences.zh: 有时候它表现得非常出色，接连不断地完成任务，但偶尔它也会犯蠢。

sentences.en: Or maybe it's not even stupid.
sentences.zh: 或者说，这甚至算不上犯蠢。

sentences.en: It just misunderstands what you want and you need to hold its hand.
sentences.zh: 它只是误解了你的意图，你需要引导它。

sentences.en: You need to guide it, point it in the right direction and send it off.
sentences.zh: 你需要指引它，给它指明正确的方向，然后让它继续工作。

sentences.en: And sometimes that phase where you're guiding it, it'll last for 30 minutes, 40 minutes in order for you to guide it in the direction.
sentences.zh: 有时候这个引导阶段会持续 30 到 40 分钟，才能让它走上正轨。

sentences.en: But in the case where, you know, you porting, you know, 1,700 lines of unit tests is going to take, like, days, if not like a week, it's worth it to spend that 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 但如果你要移植 1700 行单元测试，这可能需要几天甚至一周的时间，那么花这 30 分钟是非常值得的。

sentences.en: And in this case, it didn't take 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 而在这次的情况下，甚至没花到 30 分钟。

sentences.en: But there's been other cases where I've been trying to do something and it really doesn't understand.
sentences.zh: 但也有其他情况，我试图做某事，而它完全无法理解。

sentences.en: But then once I do figure out the magic incantation to get it to do exactly what I want, you know, take that incantation, throw it in a cursor rule,
sentences.zh: 但一旦我找到了让它完全按我要求执行的“咒语”，我就把那段咒语扔进 Cursor 的规则里，

sentences.en: and then the next time you want to do something like that, you just invoke the cursor rule and say, hey, do this, follow the rule, and you're good to go.
sentences.zh: 下次你想做类似的事情时，只需调用那个规则，说“嘿，照这个规则做”，一切就搞定了。

sentences.en: So that's my solo podcast, folks.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的个人播客，各位。

sentences.en: It's probably, what, how long have I been recording for?
sentences.zh: 大概，我录了多久了？

sentences.en: 10 minutes, 15 minutes?
sentences.zh: 10 分钟，15 分钟？

sentences.en: It is so sunny out.
sentences.zh: 外面阳光真好。

sentences.en: It says 13 minutes.
sentences.zh: 显示是 13 分钟。

sentences.en: So once this kit's cleaned up, little intro added, it'll probably be around 15 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 所以等这段剪辑好，加上片头，大概也就 15 分钟左右。

sentences.en: And we, oh, we do have a house finch has been recognized.
sentences.zh: 我们，哦，我们识别出了一只家朱雀。

sentences.en: A poorly named bird, in my opinion, because they're beautiful.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这鸟的名字起得很糟糕，因为它们很漂亮。

sentences.en: They got pink heads and they're a beautiful bird, but they got a very boring name of house finch, so they don't get the respect they deserve.
sentences.zh: 它们有粉红色的头，是非常漂亮的鸟，但却有一个极其无聊的名字叫“家朱雀”，所以它们没得到应有的尊重。

sentences.en: If my fiancee's listening to this, she'll be chuckling now, because I always tell her that, you know, the house sparrow and the house finch.
sentences.zh: 如果我未婚妻在听这个，她现在肯定在偷笑，因为我总是跟她说，家麻雀和家朱雀的名字都太难听了。

sentences.en: They got bad names.
sentences.zh: 它们的名字都很糟糕。

sentences.en: House sparrow, one of the most resilient birds in the world.
sentences.zh: 家麻雀，世界上生命力最顽强的鸟类之一。

sentences.en: It's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是。

sentences.en: It's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是。

sentences.en: Every country I've ever gone to, there's the house sparrow, kicking around.
sentences.zh: 我去过的每个国家，都有家麻雀在蹦跶。

sentences.en: Anyways, there's vibe coding, there's rage coding, and there's guide coding.
sentences.zh: 总之，有氛围编程、愤怒编程，还有引导式编程。

sentences.en: I implore you to give guide coding a try.
sentences.zh: 我恳请大家尝试一下引导式编程。

sentences.en: 10x your productivity, 100x your productivity.
sentences.zh: 让你的生产力提升 10 倍，甚至 100 倍。

sentences.en: This is the future.
sentences.zh: 这就是未来。

sentences.en: This is the future for software developers.
sentences.zh: 这是软件开发者的未来。

sentences.en: For some of you, you're going to be doing some gnarly template metaprogramming stuff, or constexpr metaprogramming stuff, or cutting-edge reflection metaprogramming stuff.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人可能会做一些复杂的模板元编程、constexpr 元编程，或者前沿的反射元编程。

sentences.en: And guide coding isn't going to get you very far.
sentences.zh: 引导式编程可能帮不了你太多。

sentences.en: But there is a huge set of tasks that guide coding with these LLMs are just amazing for.
sentences.zh: 但对于大量任务来说，利用这些大语言模型进行引导式编程简直太棒了。

sentences.en: And it's only going to get better from here.
sentences.zh: 而且未来只会越来越好。

sentences.en: So that's my pitch.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的推介。

sentences.en: Which we say goodbye to the American crows, to the Canadian geese, and to the house finches.
sentences.zh: 我们要向美洲乌鸦、加拿大雁和家朱雀告别了。

sentences.en: We did not get an appearance from the mitred parakeet.
sentences.zh: 我们没能见到红额鹦哥。

sentences.en: It's very unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 非常遗憾。

sentences.en: And with that, I will say I hope you have a fantastic day and weekend, if you're listening to this on Friday or Saturday, or Sunday.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果你是在周五、周六或周日听这段节目，祝你度过愉快的一天和周末。

sentences.en: Expect to hear from Ben and I next week, where we will be chatting about a number of topics.
sentences.zh: 期待下周我和 Ben 的节目，我们将讨论很多话题。

sentences.en: Maybe we'll talk about the cost of commuting.
sentences.zh: 也许我们会谈谈通勤的成本。

sentences.en: One of my favorite combinators, the C Combinator, the Cardinal, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的组合子之一，C 组合子，即基数组合子，也就是

sentences.en: Flip and Haskell, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: Flip and Haskell, a.k.a.

sentences.en: Commute in the Array Languages.
sentences.zh: 数组语言中的“交换”。

sentences.en: I posted that tweet, I don't know how many days or weeks ago at this point.
sentences.zh: 我发过那条推文，不知道是几天还是几周前了。

sentences.en: It was a work of art called The Cost of Commuting.
sentences.zh: 那是一件名为《通勤的成本》的艺术品。

sentences.en: Maybe we'll chat about that.
sentences.zh: 也许我们会聊聊那个。

sentences.en: Maybe we'll chat about something else.
sentences.zh: 也许我们会聊聊别的。

sentences.en: Until then, have a good one.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，祝一切顺利。
